name: pmax-copy
description: Produce, rewrite, and review Google PMAX text assets. Use when the user requests PMAX ads, headlines and descriptions, stronger reasons to click, or a complete copy rewrite. Start from Persona, USP, and evidence; establish the entry point, need scenario, and landing page, then express the same scenario through S / N / T / F. Deliver a 15 / 5 / 5 pool of independently recombinable assets with item-by-item review. Match images and videos only after copy completion; this skill does not cover RSA formatting or ad account operations
